environment_freeze.historical_seed_status: REPRODUCED_BYTE_FOR_BYTE on the anchor: the 13-package subset hashes to this value with zero differences across all 13 packages. Normalisation convention is LF-terminated, alphabetically sorted Name==Version, including pip and setuptools.

environment_freeze.environment_defect: /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.11/bin/python3.11 is a zero-byte launcher; only python3.11-intel64 runs. Any surface identity check must verify an actually-executing interpreter, not a PATH entry.

two_anchors_preserved_distinct.distinction_law: The two are separate evidence grades. The source-free anchor is NOT reused as reader-side physical evidence, and neither is inherited by name alone.

reader_option_freeze.ordered_category_behaviour: UNORDERED. No ordered categorical arises under this configuration.

PER_SOURCE_READER_LANES.law: A physical-metadata digest is frozen only as (source identity, exact reader configuration/lane). The warrant must bind both per source. A source identity alone is insufficient.
PER_SOURCE_READER_LANES.digest_coupling_evidence: The same synthetic DTA produced digest 5f58388491b1e41424b177f966c5d61032f5f88f344f0403cfad203ca19f315a on the encoding=latin1 lane and f9148f36ba2b58a8a6386c4a7f8fff796dfb6a0a4a4fc7418043ae8849f727e6 on the encoding=None lane, while file_metadata was identical (0 differing keys). The difference is reader_configuration: encoding and authority_status are inside the digest payload.

resource_accounting_law.portability_warning: ru_maxrss is bytes on Darwin and kibibytes on Linux, a 1024x difference. A budget measured on one OS must never be relabelled across the OS boundary.
resource_accounting_law.run_requirement: Peak RSS and any other OS-defined resource measure must be published with the unit law attached.
